BackstoryDef.title: arcane prodigy
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] showed early aptitude for things that didn't quite make sense: fires that bent toward [PAWN_objective], animals that went quiet when [PAWN_pronoun] was anxious, books that fell open to the relevant page. The guild's recruiter arrived before [PAWN_pronoun] turned twelve. [PAWN_pronoun] was told it was an opportunity. [PAWN_pronoun]'s family was told it was an honor. Neither party was entirely wrong.

BackstoryDef.title: scholar's ward
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in the household of a guild wizard, not a student exactly, more a useful presence: fetching things, copying notes, asking questions that [PAWN_possessive] guardian had already stopped finding interesting. [PAWN_pronoun] absorbed more than was probably intended. When [PAWN_pronoun] applied for formal membership, the guild interviewed [PAWN_objective] for three hours and accepted [PAWN_objective] before the day was out.

BackstoryDef.title: guild apprentice
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has been a guild apprentice for long enough that calling [PAWN_objective] an apprentice has become quietly embarrassing to both parties. The guild does not rush advancement. [PAWN_pronoun] copies manuscripts, catalogs acquisitions, and attends lectures that are occasionally taught by people who remember when the events discussed were current events. [PAWN_pronoun] learns something useful every few weeks. The rest of the time, [PAWN_pronoun] files.

BackstoryDef.title: guild wizard
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] holds a full guild rank and a specialization, which means [PAWN_pronoun] is expected to be useful rather than promising. [PAWN_possessive] research produces results on schedule, [PAWN_possessive] commissions return completed, and [PAWN_possessive] quarterly filings are submitted on time. The guild considers this exceptional. [PAWN_pronoun] does not.

BackstoryDef.title: guild warlock
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has held the rank of Warlock for some years now, which is to say [PAWN_pronoun] is senior enough to be consulted and not senior enough to be blamed. [PAWN_pronoun] runs a laboratory, supervises two or three apprentices, and has a working theory that is either brilliant or incorrect, a distinction [PAWN_pronoun] expects to settle within the decade. The archmage has twice referred to [PAWN_objective] as indispensable, which [PAWN_pronoun] has noted is not the same as appreciated.

BackstoryDef.title: library page
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] fetched books for the scholars at a guildhall library. Nobody taught [PAWN_objective] to read, so [PAWN_pronoun] taught [PAWN_objective]self from the spines and the catalog cards.

BackstoryDef.title: alchemist's child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in the back of an apothecary, grinding roots and sorting mushrooms into jars. [PAWN_pronoun] learned which ingredients heal and which ones kill by watching what [PAWN_possessive] parent kept on the top shelf.

BackstoryDef.title: guild alchemist
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] works the guild's alchemy bench, brewing restoratives for the healers and stranger things for the researchers. [PAWN_pronoun] keeps careful notes, because the one time [PAWN_pronoun] did not, [PAWN_pronoun] lost [PAWN_possessive] eyebrows for a month.

BackstoryDef.title: guild healer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] studied Restoration and took a post treating the sick who came to the guildhall door. [PAWN_pronoun] charges the rich and does not charge the poor, and the guild has stopped asking [PAWN_objective] to change that.

BackstoryDef.title: guild enchanter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] binds souls into steel for a living. [PAWN_possessive] rings and blades sell well to adventurers, and [PAWN_pronoun] has spent years trying to explain to them why a petty soul will not make a sword that kills dragons.
